src/dm-cordn-adapter.ts.name: Cordn messaging option
src/dm-cordn-adapter.ts.description: Sends and receives private messages through Cordn group messaging over ContextVM, storing them in memory.

src/dm-memory-store.ts.name: In-memory conversations
src/dm-memory-store.ts.description: Keeps private messages grouped by conversation in memory, with paging for conversation and message lists.

src/dm-ndr-adapter.ts.name: Double Ratchet messaging option
src/dm-ndr-adapter.ts.description: Sends and receives private messages with Nostr Double Ratchet encryption, carried over Kehto's relay hooks.

src/dm-nip17-adapter.ts.name: NIP-17 messaging option
src/dm-nip17-adapter.ts.description: Sends and receives private messages in the NIP-17 sealed-message format through a relay pool.

src/dm-service.ts.name: Private messages service
src/dm-service.ts.description: Answers napplet requests to list, read, send and follow private messages, after relay approval, using the chosen messaging option.

src/dm-types.ts.name: Private message shapes
src/dm-types.ts.description: Describes the relay pool and messaging-option contract the private messages service relies on.
